preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, the initial size of the square n_i must be between 1 and 10^9.
For each test case, the number of splitting operations k_i must be between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.description: If the number of operations k_i is at least 2^(n_i - 1), output 'YES'; otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and log2_side == n_i - 1 if k_i >= 2**(n_i - 1) else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the log2 of the side length of the path must be n_i - 1.
